annotations.title: US federal debt interest cost (monthly, FYTD, YoY, effective rate)

description: US federal debt interest cost (monthly, FYTD, YoY, effective rate) — How much is the US paying in interest on the national debt? From Treasury Fiscal Data: latest month and fiscal-year-to-date interest expense (public issues vs intragovernmental trust-fund interest), year-over-year change, annualized pace, trailing 12 months, last full fiscal year, breakdown by component and by security type (notes, bonds, bills, TIPS, FRN), an approximate effective rate on debt held by the public, a RISING/FLAT/FALLING trend, 24 months of history, and the current debt composition (total debt, held by public, intragovernmental, marketable mix with shares) from the Monthly Statement of the Public Debt. No parameters. US$ billions. Public domain. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: econ_debt_interest
